payload.text: **With the next kovacs-sysadm message (Gtools' kovacs check):** utilz-vc's /var/tmp check. `find /var/tmp -maxdepth 1 -name 'dc-*' | sort` should list only dc-2141-lua.UHvvGX and dc-2141-sc090.vbubq3, which stay. If any dc-2144-* is listed, run `rm -f /var/tmp/dc-2144-*`, then the find again; dc-2144-request.md may be there. Send the answer to utilz-vc. Never ask for `utilz use` on kovacs (hv's rule).
